CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidate_claimed ON candidates(lane,claim_until) WHERE claim IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidate_delivery ON candidates(lane,priority,deadline,id,generation)
          WHERE result IS NOT NULL AND completed=desired;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidate_generation_identity ON candidates(id,generation);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidate_lane_identity ON candidates(lane,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidate_pending ON candidates(lane,pending,priority,deadline);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidate_retirement ON candidates(observed) WHERE pending=? AND claim IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS evidence_retention_order ON evidence(namespace,created DESC,key DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pons_watch_due ON pons_current_watch(next_at,attempt,candidate);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rolling_retirement ON rolling(at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS transition_retention_order ON transitions(seq,candidate);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS candidates(
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,lane TEXT NOT NULL,generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
          interpretation TEXT NOT NULL,latest_id TEXT NOT NULL,observed REAL NOT NULL,
          ordering TEXT NOT NULL,desired TEXT NOT NULL,completed TEXT,
          payload TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT,pending INTEGER NOT NULL,
          priority INTEGER NOT NULL,rank REAL NOT NULL,deadline REAL NOT NULL,queued REAL NOT NULL,
          claim TEXT,owner TEXT,claim_generation INTEGER,claim_until REAL,result TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observation_archive(candidate TEXT PRIMARY KEY,ordering TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observation_counts(lane TEXT PRIMARY KEY,received INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipt_cache_usage(namespace TEXT PRIMARY KEY,bytes INTEGER,records INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS result_consumption(candidate TEXT,generation INTEGER,at REAL,
          PRIMARY KEY(candidate,generation));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runtime(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service(lane TEXT,seconds REAL,logical INTEGER,physical INTEGER,at REAL);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS history_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON transitions
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,?); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS history_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON transitions
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,?); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS observations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON observations
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,?); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS observations_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON observations
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,?); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS receipt_cache_delete AFTER DELETE ON evidence
          WHEN OLD.namespace LIKE ? BEGIN
          UPDATE receipt_cache_usage SET bytes=bytes-length(CAST(OLD.key||OLD.body||OLD.provenance AS BLOB)),
            records=records-? WHERE namespace=OLD.namespace; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS receipt_cache_insert AFTER INSERT ON evidence
          WHEN NEW.namespace LIKE ? BEGIN
          INSERT INTO receipt_cache_usage VALUES(NEW.namespace,
            length(CAST(NEW.key||NEW.body||NEW.provenance AS BLOB)),?)
          ON CONFLICT(namespace) DO UPDATE SET bytes=bytes+excluded.bytes,records=records+?; END;
